title: Add gender/relation consistency validations to the Family detail section of both
description:
[The user currently has the "Candidate Onboarding Record" screen open (object emponb_candidate_record, type T). Resolve "this", "this form/page/screen", or "here" to this object unless they name a different one.]

When selecting "Gender" and "Relation" in "Family" section of both "Candidate Onboarding Record" and "Candidate Self" page, restrict user and show an appropriate message if the following combinations are selected; for both the fields: 
A. Combination: Female + Brother, Message: "Brother cannot be female".
B. Combination: Female + Father, Message: "Father cannot be female."
C. Combination: Female + GrandFather, Message: "GrandFather cannot be female."
D. Combination: Male + Mother, Message: "Mother cannot be male."
E. Combination: Male + Sister, Message: "Sister cannot be male."
F. Combination: Male + GrandMother, Message: "GrandMother cannot be male."
G. Combination: Female + Son, Message: "Son cannot be female"
H. Combination: Female + Husband, Message: "Husband cannot be female"
I. Combination: Male + Wife, Message: "Wife cannot be male"
J. Combination: Male + Daughter, Message: "Daughter cannot be male"

I have attached form screenshot for the reference, check it and do the changes accordingly.

todos.label: Document the Gender/Relation consistency rule in the FRS
Add Gender/Relation combination validations to the Family detail of Candidate Onboarding Record
Add the same Gender/Relation combination validations to the Family detail of Candidate Self
